purpose: Draws a stakeholder card as one merged card per person, with the holder's rows and the person's rows in one frame.
namedChanges: the imports are the peers': `bareForm` from `vocabulary-source`; `birthdayText` from `birthday-text`; `displayPlacements` and the type `PersonCard` from `person-connections`; the types `OneCardField`, `OneCardGroup`, `OneCardRow`, `OwnAddress` from `one-card-merge`; `createOnlineCardController`, the types `OnlineCardController`, `OnlineCardState` and `WORDS` from `online-card`; `readLink` and the type `LinkReading` from `online-card-link`; `OneCardFoot` from `one-card-rows`; `CardGroup` from `card-group`; `OneCardProvider`, `oneCardOf`, `placeOneCard`, `useOneCard` and the type `OneCardView` from `one-card-context`; `eventTargetInTopDialog` and `modalIsOpen` from `open-popups`; `claimPlaceIds` from `place-lines`; `refreshRecordInCaches` from `record-cache-kit`; `onlineCardDeps`, `bindAnchorShare`, `forgetAnchor`, `sharedAnchor`, `anchorShareOf`, `resolveRecordPersonCard` and the type `AnchorShare` from `stakeholder-list-doors`; `forgetLinkedFinds` from `stakeholder-list-state`; `attributeLabel` from `term-slots`; the files of the unit import each other by `./name` (in the source: `gilb-stakeholders`, `gilb-stakeholders-ui` and the app's own files);

`OneCardFind.tsx` and `ConnectedMarker.tsx`: `import { ONLINE_CARD_WORDS as W } from "gilb-stakeholders"` is `import { WORDS as W } from "@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-online-card"` (the package exported the controller's `WORDS` under that name; both files use `W` as before);

the host (RuleGhsHostSeam): seven expressions that reach the MyNet place and geo libraries become members of `OneCardHost` (`src/oneCardHost.ts`, new): `isGeoEntityId`, `listPlaceClaimsInVault`, `claimsAbout`, `claimFieldText`, `loadPlaceNames`, `placeClaimsKey` and `placeClaimsStaleMs` (the constant `PLACE_CLAIMS_STALE_MS`); the context `OneCardHostContext` is read by `useOneCardHost()`, which throws "The one card needs a OneCardHostContext.Provider above it." when there is none;

`OneCardBody.tsx`, before: `export function isTheirPlaceGroup(group: OneCardGroup, groupOf: ...): boolean` with `isGeoEntityId(r.value.trim())` in its body; after: `isTheirPlaceGroup(host: OneCardHost, group, groupOf)` with `host.isGeoEntityId(r.value.trim())`; in `OneCardBody` the first statement after the props is `const host = useOneCardHost();` and the call is `isTheirPlaceGroup(host, g, props.groupOf)`;

`heldAddresses.ts`, before: `ownAddressOf(claim, places)` with `claimFieldText(claim, "streetLine")`, `"addressLine1"`, `"addressLine2"`, `"postalCode"`; after: `ownAddressOf(host, claim, places)` with `host.claimFieldText(claim, ...)` for the same four terms. In `useHeldAddresses` the first statement is `const host = useOneCardHost();`; `placeClaimsKey(vaultId ?? "")` is `host.placeClaimsKey(vaultId ?? "")`, `listPlaceClaimsInVault(vaultId!)` is `host.listPlaceClaimsInVault(vaultId!)`, `PLACE_CLAIMS_STALE_MS` is `host.placeClaimsStaleMs`, `claimsAbout(q.data, subject!)` is `host.claimsAbout(q.data, subject!)`, `loadPlaceNames(ids)` is `host.loadPlaceNames(ids)` and `ownAddressOf(c, ...)` is `ownAddressOf(host, c, ...)`. The dependency lists of the hook's memos are as in the source (the host does not change);

the types `PlaceClaim` and `GeoPlace` (MyNet interfaces, `lib/mynet/place/placeClaim.ts:123` and `lib/mynet/geo/baseGeo.ts:280`) are declared in `src/oneCardHost.ts` as the structural subsets the unit reads: `PlaceClaim` is `PlaceLineClaim` of `place-lines` plus `uri`; `GeoPlace` is `id`, `label`, `type`, `memberOf`; `PlaceTextTerm` is the four terms;

`claimPlaceIds` is the one of `place-lines` (72 tokens each; the unit's parameter type is `PlaceLineClaim` and its lambda parameter is named `candidate` where the app's is `f`; measured equal on 5000 random claims);

comments made generic (cycle, step, tester, design-note and ruling tags, dates, person and app names and a spec reference removed; the example host address in `theirPlaces.ts` reworded); no code changed. No string literal carries a tag.

0.2.0: `theirValueText` returns a `ReactNode` and a row on the language term (`a:languageUsed`, by term) is drawn by `LanguageRow` of the unit `language-row` in both the linked and the single-source view (`valueText` of `unlinkedView`); every other field is unchanged. This is new behaviour, not a port: the source draws the language's address there. The comment-stripped file differs from the 0.1.0 file in exactly these lines (new function `languageUsedText`, `theirValueText`, `unlinkedView`'s `valueText`, plus one import).

0.3.0: `skillText(value, label)` (new, private) replaces `labelFor(row.value) || row.value.split("/").pop() || row.value` in the linked view's `valueText` for the skill field: the label, else `referentNameOf(value)` of `term-name-text`, else "A skill" for any other address, else the text itself. The `languageUsed` and birthday paths and the unlinked view are unchanged.

Beyond the source (Kai, 2026-11-01): optional host members `addressSpellings` and `readPlaceNames`, and `useTheirAddresses`, read the place names of an address of theirs (city, region, country, country id) and say honestly when a place of that address was not read (`unread`) or is gone (`gone`). `orderPlaces` is the finest-first sort `ownAddressOf` already used, now shared. Absent either member, or the read not enabled, or the fields not in hand: no request, and the card stays as before. No drawing.

Beyond the source (Kai, 2026-11-01): `useTheirAddresses` in `ready` also returns `rest`, the input fields minus every field that went into an address (a label whose `sourceEntity` is an address id, and a part whose predicate is one of the five part spellings and whose `composite` is an address id, including a duplicate the grouping ignored). Loose parts and every other field stay, in order. `OneCardBody`, for a linked card whose online card is ready and which names `addressPredicate`, builds the merge from `rest` and from those addresses once the read is `ready`, and draws the plain address line as the row. While the read is off, reading or failed, the card is exactly as before. An address's places are not handed to Details; a loose place still is.
